description: Test suite for Customer doctype in ERPNext, including unit tests for customer details, address handling, renaming, credit limits, and related functionalities.

classes.name: TestCustomer
classes.description: Unit test class for Customer doctype functionalities in ERPNext.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates test Item if not exists.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets credit limit for test customer.

methods.name: test_get_customer_group_details
methods.description: Tests retrieval of customer group details and associated accounts and credit limits.

methods.name: test_party_details
methods.description: Validates party details retrieval for a customer, including contact and address info.

methods.name: test_party_details_tax_category
methods.description: Checks tax category determination based on billing/shipping address and settings.

methods.name: test_rename
methods.description: Tests renaming of customer documents and associated comments linkage.

methods.name: test_freezed_customer
methods.description: Verifies behavior when customer is frozen, expecting exception on sales order creation.

methods.name: test_delete_customer_contact
methods.description: Tests deletion of customer and associated primary contact.

methods.name: test_disabled_customer
methods.description: Checks behavior when customer is disabled, expecting exception on sales order creation.

methods.name: test_duplicate_customer
methods.description: Tests creation of duplicate customer and verifies naming conventions.

methods.name: get_customer_outstanding_amount
methods.description: Calculates outstanding amount for a customer, creating transactions if needed.

methods.name: test_customer_credit_limit
methods.description: Validates credit limit enforcement across sales order, delivery note, and sales invoice.

methods.name: test_customer_credit_limit_on_change
methods.description: Checks validation when changing credit limits for a customer.

methods.name: test_customer_payment_terms
methods.description: Tests calculation of due date based on payment terms and templates.
